root_causes_and_fixes: Draw Cuboid hid an internally open popover with display:none. React now controls open and closes it when drawing starts or the control is disabled.
The repeat-drawing tooltip was placed above the buttons over Auto Fit. Cuboid button tooltips now use bottom placement.

Allure serialized DOM/scene assertion values without bounds. A listener registered before Allure bounds diagnostic actual/expected for Auto Fit specs while preserving the original error and FAIL status.
